name: Full name
rolesBody: Admin: everything, including selling prices to Hoa Huy, payables, RFQ quotations, input prices and users.|Staff: confirm orders, delivery dates, claims, documents, fill in input prices. Cannot see selling prices to Hoa Huy or payables.|View only: view orders and claims. No editing, no prices.|Input prices only: can only view the Input prices section.
securityBody: The company always keeps at least one Admin. The email code is only asked on activation, a new device or a password reset; every new device sends a notification email. Locking an account signs that person out immediately. All actions are logged per person.

err.lastAdmin: The company must always keep at least one Admin.
